summary: Extended task-lock.sh's cmd_acquire with a mutex-guarded cross-task file_scope overlap check that composes with the existing task-number lock: a fresh overlapping foreign lock refuses (exit 1) and a stale overlapping foreign lock warns and proceeds (exit 0) without ever mutating the foreign lock, reusing file-footprint-overlap.md's directory-prefix algorithm exactly via a new scopes_overlap() jq helper, and closing the scan-then-mkdir TOCTOU race with a short-lived specs/.scope-lock/ mutex that fails closed (exit 2) on timeout. acquire's signature and 0/1/2 exit-code contract are fully preserved (zero call-site changes, so task 810's future gate-script wiring inherits this behavior for free). All edits were insert-only around task 808's concurrent init-marker additions to the same file, verified disjoint via git diff -U1. All 8 sandbox scenarios plus 3 regression scenarios passed in a scratchpad sandbox that never touched the live specs/ tree, and all three dual-copy pairs (task-lock.sh, task-lock.md, and a newly-discovered extensions/core copy of file-footprint-overlap.md) are byte-identical.
